direction: Night Signal: premium, dark, calm-before-the-alarm. Background: deep navy #0B1020 with a subtle vertical gradient to #141B3A at the bottom, and behind the phone a set of concentric soft rings and five tall rounded waveform bars rendered as thin gradient strokes from violet #6C38FC to cyan #02CEF0 (subtle, like a sound pulse, no lens flare). Typography: a heavy geometric sans (Manrope ExtraBold style), sentence case, tight leading, headline color white #FFFFFF; the accent word filled with a left-to-right gradient from violet #6C38FC to cyan #02CEF0. Subheadline in #A9B3D1, regular weight. Device: iPhone 17 Pro Max in a black titanium frame with thin bezels and a soft violet-tinted shadow. No character, no mascot.

screens.screen_notes: The screen shows the "MY SOUNDS" list exactly as in Image 1: six rows with square cover thumbnails and the titles Yawning Cat Meme, Crowd Goes Wild, Sunday Vinyl, Stair Sprint Speech, Neon Anime Opening, Rooftop Sunrise, each with a duration, the date Oct 30, 2026, a blue play button and a chevron; tab bar with Alarms and Sounds at the bottom. Row alignment invariant: in every row the blue play button and grey chevron sit on the SAME horizontal line as that row's title, vertically centered in the row, exactly as in Image 1; rows stay evenly spaced and the thumbnails, titles and buttons of one row never drift into the next row.

screens.sub: Pull the sound from any video you saved.
screens.screen_notes: The screen is the "ADD A SOUND" sheet exactly as in Image 1: a Close button, the step label "01 — PICK A SOURCE", the large title "Bring in a sound.", the paragraph below it, and two rows: "01  Audio file — MP3 or M4A from Files" and "02  Video — Pull audio from a clip", each with its icon and an arrow.

screens.sub: Trim it to the exact second.
screens.screen_notes: The screen is the "TRIM & NAME" sheet exactly as in Image 1: "Shape your sound.", "Drag the handles to trim.", the sunset city cover thumbnail with a pencil badge, TITLE "Rooftop Sunrise", and the waveform with the dark selected section between two handles, grey unselected bars outside it, a thin playhead line, the times 0:40, 0:40 and 1:20 below, and the round pause button. Make sure the waveform selection and handles stay clearly visible.

The screen is the full-screen iPhone alarm alert exactly as in Image 1: black background, a small alarm clock icon with "Nap’s over", the huge time "5:13", "AlarmiFex" below it, a wide blue "Snooze" button with orange text, and the "slide to stop" control at the bottom. Keep the screen black; there is no status bar in Image 1, do not add one.

screens.sub: Hype on weekdays. Calm on Sundays.
screens.screen_notes: The screen is the "AlarmiFex" alarm list exactly as in Image 1: rows 5:45 AM Leg day Tue, Thu; 6:00 AM – 6:30 AM Easy mornings · 3 sounds · Weekdays; 6:30 AM Sunrise run Weekdays; 7:15 AM Class at 8 Mon, Wed, Fri; 9:30 AM Sunday slow Sun; 10:00 AM Game day Sat; every row has a green toggle switched on; the + button top right and the Alarms/Sounds tab bar.

The screen is the "Calm" category grid exactly as in Image 1: a back button, the title "Calm", and the two-column grid of photo cards with their titles, creators, "Calm" tags, durations and orange PRO badges.

screens.sub: A series of sounds, 15 minutes apart.
screens.screen_notes: The screen is the "Timeline" sheet exactly as in Image 1: back, Edit and Save buttons; three timeline rows 6:00 AM Sunday Vinyl, 6:15 AM Rooftop Sunrise, 6:30 AM Crowd Goes Wild, each with its cover thumbnail, the small grey word "classic" under the title, and a round play button; "Add Sound"; "3 alarms · every 15 min"; Label "Easy mornings"; and the Volume slider.

The screen is the "Edit Alarm" sheet exactly as in Image 1: Cancel and Save buttons, the time wheel set to 6:30 AM, "Alarm in 13h 15m", Label "Sunrise run", Repeat with M T W T F highlighted blue and S S grey plus the Weekdays/Weekends/Every Day/Clear chips, and Sound "Alarm Sound — Rooftop Sunrise" with the volume slider near the maximum.
